title: HA-WhatsMiner · M60VK2A history
description: Hourly board snapshots from InfluxDB 2 / Flux. WEB-to-PCB correspondence remains unverified. See GRAFANA.md.

list.name: boards
list.label: Board maps (up to 3)
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: ${bucket:doublequote}, tag: "entity_id",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "whatsminer_chip_snapshots", start: -730d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: ${bucket:doublequote}, tag: "entity_id",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "whatsminer_chip_snapshots", start: -730d)

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.query: Temperature : temperature, Voltage (raw) : voltage_raw, Frequency (raw) : frequency_raw, Errors : errors, CRC errors : crc_errors, Nonce : nonce, Repeat : repeat, x (first) : x, x (second) : x_secondary, pct (first %) : pct, pct (second %) : pct_secondary

panels.title: M60VK2A chip snapshots
panels.description: To selects the historical moment. Hover for all chip metrics. Timestamps are UTC. Missing readings are gray. U labels and some positions are assumed; see GRAFANA.md.

targets.query:
// The right edge of the dashboard time range selects a historical moment.
// Only one bounded window is read, even when inspecting a date a year ago.
snapshotStart = time(v: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: duration(v: "${lookback}")))
from(bucket: ${bucket:doublequote})
  |> range(start: snapshotStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "whatsminer_chip_snapshots" and r._field == "chip_snapshot_str" and r.domain == "sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^${boards:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "entity_id"])
